assessment.reasoning: SPX closed at 7,398.93 on May 8, 2026 — a record high. To hit 7,600 requires only ~2.7% upside, with about 7.5 months remaining. Momentum is strongly positive (longest weekly winning streak since 2024) and the typical SPX maximum within an 8-month window is well above 5% even in flat regimes. Probability of touching this level once is high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: A sustained risk-off shock (tariff escalation, Fed mistake) could prevent any 7,600 print, but base rate for one print over 8 months is high given current proximity.
